source.title: A Quantitative Analysis and Guidelines of Data Streaming Accelerator in Modern Intel Xeon Scalable Processors (ASPLOS'24)
source.summary: Comprehensive evaluation of Intel DSA as a high-performance data copy and transformation accelerator introduced in Sapphire Rapids, covering data-movement operations, CRC32/DIF/delta-record offload, and a DPDK Vhost case study with programmer guidelines. CC BY 4.0.
